user.title: Connect GeORG
user.description: Create an API access with the permission "Heizungssteuerung" in GeORG under Organisationseinstellungen → API-Zugänge. Use a separate API access for every Home Assistant installation.

data_description.url: Address of your GeORG instance, e.g. {example_url}
data_description.token: The token is shown only once when the API access is created.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew GeORG token
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {url} is no longer valid. Create a new token for the API access in GeORG and enter it here.

error.cannot_connect: GeORG cannot be reached. Check the address.
error.https_required: GeORG must be reached via https:// so the token is transmitted encrypted.
error.invalid_auth: The token is invalid, the API access is disabled or lacks the permission "Heizungssteuerung".
error.module_missing: The module "Heizungssteuerung" is not booked in GeORG.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one GeORG instance can be connected.

init.title: GeORG heating control
init.description: Assign heaters and sensors to GeORG rooms. Only assigned rooms are reported to GeORG. Changes take effect after saving.

select_room.title: Choose room
select_room.description: ✓ = already assigned, ⚠ = no longer known in GeORG (remove the assignment by clearing all fields).

room.title: {room}
room.description: Clear all fields to remove the room from the assignment.

data_description.heaters: Thermostats (climate) and switchable heaters (switch) of the room.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Optional. Without a sensor the current temperature of the first thermostat is used.

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant reports to GeORG. The switching accuracy depends on this interval.
data_description.failsafe_grace: If GeORG cannot be reached, a heating room is switched off locally this long after the end of its heating window.

abort.cannot_connect: GeORG cannot be reached, the rooms could not be loaded.
abort.invalid_auth: The token is no longer valid.
abort.module_missing: The module "Heizungssteuerung" is not booked in GeORG.
abort.no_rooms: There are no rooms with active heating control in GeORG.

connection_lost.title: GeORG unreachable for a long time
connection_lost.description: Home Assistant has not been able to reach GeORG ({url}) for more than 12 hours. Heaters are not switched according to room bookings. Rooms whose heating window has ended are switched off locally.

module_missing.title: GeORG module "Heizungssteuerung" not booked
module_missing.description: GeORG ({url}) answers that the module "Heizungssteuerung" is not booked for your organisation. Book the module or remove the integration.

unknown_room.title: Reassign room {room}
unknown_room.description: GeORG no longer knows the room "{room}" (ID `{room_id}`) or its heating control was disabled – for example because its short name (slug) was changed. The room is no longer reported. Open the integration options and assign the heaters to the correct room.
